topic: The NSS Lifecycle axis: how files evolve (versioning, changelogs, deprecation state, migration guides, feature-flag lifecycle, SBOM evidence, ADR-driven decisions, negative states)

subtopics.scope: The eight-stage lifecycle state machine (experimental/beta/stable/deprecated/removed/archived/cancelled/unknown), per-transition entry and exit criteria, compatibility promises, the yubiOS stage-semantics table, and alignment with Kubernetes, Google, and Square notice policies.
seed_queries: Kubernetes API deprecation policy notice period beta stable
API lifecycle stages experimental beta stable deprecated removed archived policy

subtopics.scope: SemVer 2.0.0 as the compatibility rule rather than the lifecycle model: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH increment semantics, the version coordinates introduced_in/last_changed_in/deprecated_in/removed_in/current_version, and why a version number cannot express stage obligations.
seed_queries: SemVer 2.0.0 specification semantic versioning MAJOR MINOR PATCH rules
semver deprecation minor release removal major release backward compatibility

subtopics.scope: Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 categories (Added/Changed/Deprecated/Removed/Fixed/Security) and what makes a good deprecation entry, Conventional Commits 1.0.0 type-to-increment mapping, and Release Drafter automation consuming explicit lifecycle metadata.
seed_queries: Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 categories Added Changed Deprecated Removed Fixed Security
Conventional Commits 1.0.0 spec feat fix BREAKING CHANGE versioning release drafter

subtopics.scope: RFC 8594 Sunset versus RFC 9745 Deprecation headers for HTTP APIs, the deprecation link relation, the ordering rule that Sunset must not precede deprecation, and notice periods as policy choices (180 days, Google, Square).

RFC 8594 Sunset HTTP header field API deprecation

subtopics.scope: Migration-guide composition: replacement symbol or endpoint, codemod availability, upgrade-helper, manual steps, and validation procedure, grounded in real codemod practice such as Next.js codemods and Node.js userland migrations.

API migration guide codemod deprecation best practices software upgrade

subtopics.scope: Per-flag lifecycle records (purpose, owner, temporary/permanent, expiry, environments, variations, code references, removal PR, archive date), LaunchDarkly flag lifecycle statuses, and OpenFeature provider-state observability.

SBOM retention policy versioned evidence artifact lifecycle
